churn_resistance.rationale: Excellent centralization and types-at-boundaries that would keep a framework upgrade to a few files; docked for the docs-contradicting verbatimModuleSyntax flag, one internal router property, no typecheck gate in build, and the hard-coded dist/server/server.js path.

findings.issue: "verbatimModuleSyntax": true is explicitly advised against by the current TanStack Start docs, which warn it "can result in server bundles leaking into client bundles". It is only benign today because every type import in the app consistently uses `import type`.
findings.suggestion: Remove verbatimModuleSyntax (as the Start docs recommend) or add a lint rule preventing value imports of src/server/* from client files so the guarantee doesn't depend on convention.

findings.issue: matches.some((m) => m.status === 'notFound' || m._notFound) reads _notFound, an internal, undocumented match property (the documented RouteMatch type exposes only status: 'notFound').
findings.suggestion: Drop the || m._notFound clause and rely on the public m.status === 'notFound' check.

findings.issue: The build script is "vite build" with no typecheck, so the app's 124 lines of type annotations are never verified in the build (the Start hosting docs' own script is "vite build && tsc --noEmit").
findings.suggestion: Add "build": "vite build && tsc --noEmit" (or a separate "typecheck" used in CI).

findings.issue: Hard-coded import of './dist/server/server.js' couples npm start to the framework's current SSR output filename; a Start release that renames the entry (the shape already differs between Vite .output and dist layouts) breaks startup with an opaque module-not-found.
findings.suggestion: Add a startup assertion with a clear error message if the path is missing, and note the coupling in a comment pointing at the Start hosting doc.

findings.issue: String(a).localeCompare(String(b)) without an explicit locale makes sort order depend on the host locale, so ordering can differ between environments (and across future runtime changes).
findings.suggestion: Pass an explicit locale (e.g. localeCompare(x, 'en')) or use an Intl.Collator('en') instance for deterministic sorting.

summary: This is a current-generation TanStack Start 1.0 app: .validator() server functions, router-owned head/document shell, the tanstackStart Vite plugin, and a lean zero-dep srvx production server, all pinned to today's latest stable releases. Data access is centralized behind one PokeAPI module with typed view models at the server boundary and filter state in the URL, so framework or API changes would touch few files. The few review fixes are small: drop verbatimModuleSyntax, stop reading the internal _notFound match property, and add a typecheck to the build.
